access_boundary: This record represents the GPT-6.1 Sol release of September 29, 2026 as exposed under the gpt-6.1-sol name: OpenAI's model page lists the default snapshot and the snapshot inventory as gpt-6.1-sol with no dated snapshot, so applications cannot pin a dated revision through OpenAI, although Azure Foundry documents the version as gpt-6.1-sol (2026-09-29). It is a release with its own name, knowledge cutoff, reasoning-effort support, and cached-input price, so GPT-6 Sol is a separate record rather than an earlier snapshot of this one. GPT-6 Astra and Luna, the GPT-5.6 Sol tier, the pro reasoning mode selected with a request parameter, ChatGPT and Codex surfaces, fine-tuned derivatives, and later generations are separate service, application, or model boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI's changelog pins the September 29, 2026 release, the model page documents modalities, limits, endpoints, and rate limits, and the model catalog lists it as a current choice
Azure Foundry documents the model with a dated version and no access request, a second managed path
tradeoffs: OpenAI documents no fixed dated snapshot, so the record cannot pin behavior the way dated-snapshot records can, and OpenAI states no retirement or deprecation posture for it
No developer-published weights are available for self-operation or independent deployment
